primitive: The frozen H,E,D2 equations and two degree-three maps; exact field reconstruction, division-polynomial torsion enumeration, map-fibre divisor pullback, and Cantor arithmetic precede kernel extraction.
coverage: Every field x-coordinate in each declared field; all nine points of each elliptic three-torsion group; all 81 pairs for the Jacobian kernel; all pairing, homomorphism and Frobenius graph identities. No full Jacobian census is asserted.
